messages:
alex: quick heads-up — we need to do a kernel+quant bundle swap tonight during the quiet window. planning a short quiesce and surge-protection handoff.
maria: ETA for the window?
alex: aiming 02:00-02:15 UTC, 15m for quiesce, 10m for swap, 20m for validation. will keep it conservative.
jamie: can you call out rollback gates? last time we got a perf jitter at 1k qps.
alex: rollback if 2x tail p95 latency or >1% error spike for 5m, or quant mismatch rate >0.5% in smoke set. also auto-pin TTL to 1h if we trigger rollback.
sam: deploy-bot, please schedule with surge-protection flag and set pin-ttl=3600 if rollback occurs.
deploy-bot: @alex scheduled deployment 4473210000 -> window 4473252000 (02:00 UTC). surge_protection=enabled. preflight smoke will run on 5% traffic slice.
sre-oncall: I'll be on call and watching the live traces. tag me if the preflight fails.
maria: release notes snippet for product: "runtime: engine kernel v7.2 + quant v4.3 — improved batching and KV cache perf; fallback improves compatibility." want to add a note about surge-protection gating.
jamie: add admin opt-out route in notes: customers can pin to previous bundle via /v1/runtime/pin if needed.
alex: on metrics: we'll monitor token p50/p95, tail latency, kv-cache misses, and quant-compat errors. telemetry dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/runtime/4473210000
sam: preflight script in staging: ```bash
./deploy-preflight --smoke-set=canonical_prompts --slice=5 --timeout=600
```
deploy-bot: preflight job queued. will post logs here.
deploy-bot: preflight passed for slice=5% in 150s. smoke regressions=0. kv-cache-misses=0.2%.
maria: good. proceed to staggered swap: region eu then na then ap. keep 5m bake per region.
jamie: remind: set deploy annotations for rollback owners + changelog link.
alex: done — annotations: owners=jamie,maria,sam; changelog=https://internal/releases/4473210000.
sre-oncall: if anything odd, I'll trigger immediate pin and escalate. otherwise I'll ack once eu bake clears.
deploy-bot: starting region eu swap (chunk 1/3) at 02:05 UTC. quiesce=true.
deploy-bot: region eu swap finished. smoke-checks passed. bake=5m.
sre-oncall: eu looks clean. p95 within baseline +5%. continuing.
deploy-bot: starting region na swap (chunk 2/3) at 02:18 UTC.
deploy-bot: na swap saw 1.6x p95 in one cluster, auto-throttle applied. traffic shifted to fallback model variant.
alex: seeing the spike in traces — rolling back na chunk. initiating pin for na region with ttl=3600.
jamie: noted. please capture heap and kernel logs: /var/log/runtime/kernel-swap.log and kvcache-stats.
sam: collect flame graphs and qperf traces. I'll open a short incident thread.
deploy-bot: na region pinned to previous bundle. bake halted for ap region pending investigation.
maria: shipping note: aborted ap swap. we'll re-run tomorrow after root cause.
sre-oncall: postmortem to follow, but initial signal points to quant kernel kernel-path mismatch on a small GPU driver variant.
alex: thanks all — good catch on surge protection doing its job. we'll schedule a rebuild with amended kernel ABI and re-run full preflight.
jamie: add follow-up tasks: 1) reproduce with 2nd driver variant, 2) add tighter canary throttle, 3) extend telemetry to capture per-kernel-signature.
maria: I'll update release notes to mark the deploy partial and link incident.
alex: great. leaving quiesce lifted and surge-protection disabled for now. reopening deploy ticket for rebuild. :thumbsup:
